name: long-doc-repeated-edits
description: Three sequential edits spread across a ~160-line document (title, deep list item, code-fence line). Probes tag rotation between edits, accurate line numbering in a long doc, and recovering from off-by-N drift on later edits.
prompt: Edit handbook.md using ONLY the read and edit tools. Make exactly these three changes, each in its OWN separate edit call, in this order: (1) change the title line to '# Service Handbook v2'; (2) change the list item '- Configuration item beta' to '- Configuration item BETA (reviewed)'; (3) change the line 'log.troubleshooting: info' to 'log.troubleshooting: debug'. Do not use any other tool.

# Service Handbook

## Overview

The service runs as a single binary with no external dependencies. It watches the config directory and reloads on change. All state is kept in memory between reloads.

```text
setting.overview: enabled
log.overview: info
retries.overview: 3
```

- Overview item alpha
- Overview item beta
- Overview item gamma
- Overview item delta
- Overview item epsilon
- Overview item zeta

## Setup

Install the binary and point it at a config directory. The first start writes a default config if none exists. Subsequent starts reuse the existing file.

```text
setting.setup: enabled
log.setup: info
retries.setup: 3
```

- Setup item alpha
- Setup item beta
- Setup item gamma
- Setup item delta
- Setup item epsilon
- Setup item zeta

## Configuration

Every setting has a sensible default. Override them per environment with a drop-in file. Unknown keys are rejected at start.

```text
setting.configuration: enabled
log.configuration: info
retries.configuration: 3
```

- Configuration item alpha
- Configuration item beta
- Configuration item gamma
- Configuration item delta
- Configuration item epsilon
- Configuration item zeta

## Daily Usage

Operators interact with the service through the status endpoint. The endpoint reports uptime, reload count, and last error. Poll it once per minute at most.

```text
setting.daily usage: enabled
log.daily usage: info
retries.daily usage: 3
```

- Daily Usage item alpha
- Daily Usage item beta
- Daily Usage item gamma
- Daily Usage item delta
- Daily Usage item epsilon
- Daily Usage item zeta

## Maintenance

Restart the service during a quiet window. A restart drops in-flight requests, so drain first. Drain via the admin endpoint before sending SIGTERM.

```text
setting.maintenance: enabled
log.maintenance: info
retries.maintenance: 3
```

- Maintenance item alpha
- Maintenance item beta
- Maintenance item gamma
- Maintenance item delta
- Maintenance item epsilon
- Maintenance item zeta

## Troubleshooting

Start with the log level raised to debug. Reproduce the issue and capture the last hundred lines. Attach them to the incident report.

```text
setting.troubleshooting: enabled
log.troubleshooting: info
retries.troubleshooting: 3
```

- Troubleshooting item alpha
- Troubleshooting item beta
- Troubleshooting item gamma
- Troubleshooting item delta
- Troubleshooting item epsilon
- Troubleshooting item zeta

## Scaling

A single instance serves up to ten thousand requests per second. Beyond that, shard by tenant identifier. Keep shard count a power of two.

```text
setting.scaling: enabled
log.scaling: info
retries.scaling: 3
```

- Scaling item alpha
- Scaling item beta
- Scaling item gamma
- Scaling item delta
- Scaling item epsilon
- Scaling item zeta

## Appendix

This section collects historical decisions. It is not consulted at runtime. Edit it only to record new decisions.

```text
setting.appendix: enabled
log.appendix: info
retries.appendix: 3
```

- Appendix item alpha
- Appendix item beta
- Appendix item gamma
- Appendix item delta
- Appendix item epsilon
- Appendix item zeta
